translation.name: Suha' Maseho: Kadadiam anna Pa'dandiam Bakahu

content: Pehapangam diona mesa to mangngambo'

Pissam wattu ma'pa'guhu oom Puang Yesus dio bihinna le'bo' Galilea. Iya sulem buda tau ma'silullu' ullombai nasuhum tä'um ia deem naongei napobua' tau buda. Iya lu längämmi Ia lopi illaam le'bo' anna muokko'i. Anna yabo ia galantangam tau buda.
Iya umpalaom buda pepa'guhuam sapo' natula' umpake pehapangam. Ma'kada naua:
“Pehingngiia', deem mesa tau le'ba' mangngambo'.
Tappana naambo' indo bannena, iya deemmi sabaheam tappa lako lalam. Iya suleim dassi naande sampe puha.
Deem tappa lako bobom batu, nasuhum masimpam tubo aka manipi' litä'na.
Sapo' tappana naalloi, iya malasso siaham nasuhum mabangi aka tä' mandalam waka'na.
Deem toi tappa lako alla' kuhha keduhi. Tappana tuttuam mahombo indo kuhha, iya umpissim indo tanangam nasuhum tä' mala kembua.
Anna sabaheam tappa lako litä' malompo. Iya mapi'dä' ia tubona nasuhum kembua tiluppi'-luppi'. Deem tiluppi' tallu pulo, deem tiluppi' annam pulo, anna deem tiluppi' sahatu'.”
Puhai ia too nauam Puang Yesus: “Lako ingganna ma'hupatau pahallu la umpatanam talinganna umpalempe sulim patomalinna anna napaillaam penabai inde tula'ku!”
Tappana angga ham Puang Yesus sola pentuhu'na anna sapulo dua pesuana, iya mekutanaim naua: “Aka hia kalembasanna indo pehapangam ingngena'?”
Iya natimba'im naua: “Angganna' iko dipaissanni indo kada ditambim diona kapahentaanna Puang Allataala. Sapo' ditula' pehapangam ia lako tau senga'.
Anna mala:

content.text: moi la nahingngi, tä' siam la naissam napekalembasam.
Aka ma'pasule manii anna naampunnii Puang Allataala.’”

content: Mane nauai: “Tä' daka tiko muissanna' inde pehapangam? Aka maka' susi, iya la tä' dia' too muissam pehapangam senga'.
Indo to mangngambo' dipasihhapam to untula' Battakadanna Puang Allataala.
Banne tappa lako lalam dipasihhapam to uhhingngi Battakadanna Puang Allataala sapo' nahappai siam tomahajanna setam.
Banne tappa lako bobom batu, dipasihhapam ia to uhhingngi Battakadanna Puang Allataala anna tappa natahima sola ponno penaba.
Sapo' tä' siam masäe aka tä' kewwaka' illaam kalena. Deenna too kamasussaam anna pandahhaam uhhuai aka untuhu'i Battakadanna Puang Allataala, iya soho' boko' siaham.

Banne tappa tama alla' kuhha keduhi dipasihhapam ia to uhhingngi Battakadanna Puang Allataala sapo' anggam malallam umpikki' salu katuboanna. Iya napakalandom ia kulle, muula' dam ia kamohäeanna lako ingganna-ingganna sia, ungkalembeim ia Battakadanna Puang Allataala nasuhum tä' mala kembua.

Anna banne tappa lako litä' malompo dipasihhapam ia to uhhingngi Battakadanna Puang Allataala anna natahima mapiai nasuhum kembua tiluppi'-luppi'. Deem tiluppi' tallu pulo, deem tiluppi' annam pulo, anna deem tiluppi' sahatu'.”
To deem kamohäeanna umpehingngii Battakadanna Puang Allataala la dihängänniam polepi
Iya ma'kada oom Puang Yesus lako tau buda naua: “Tä' tia deem tau la umpau' lampu anna nasalongo'i baka battu diua napadio ibi' sahigam sapo' napayabo hi tia inna ongeanna.
Anna mala tä' deem aka-aka la tibuni sapo' la dipatandaam asam anna tä' deem aka la disamboi sapo' la dipakaleängam asam.
Lako ingganna ma'hupatau pahallu la umpatanam talinganna umpalempe sulim patomalinna anna napaillaam penabai inde tula'ku!
Dadi pehingngii manappaia' inde pepatuduangku! Aka maka' deem kamohäeammu umpehingngii Battakadanna Puang Allataala la nahängänniam polepoko Puang Allataala.
Aka menna-menna umpaillaam penabai, tau ia too la dihängänniam polepi kapaissanganna. Sapo' to moka umpaillaam penabai, iya la diäläi pissam ia lao indo kapaissangam nasanga deemmi illaam kalena.”
Kapahentaanna Puang Allataala mellao tibuni sapo' manontom
Umpatahhu' liupi pepa'guhuanna Puang Yesus naua: “Kapahentaanna Puang Allataala sihhapam to muambo' banne lako litä'.
Puhai naambo' napelleim lao. Iya napahandu'um mukku', lobo', kendaum, kembua, sule lako kessi, tä' ia naissam indo to mangngambo' aka abana inna litä' ia umpatuboi.
Tappana matäsä' buana, iya sulem indo puäna anna nakandaoi aka lambi'um wattunna dipepahe.”
Pehapangam diona kapahentaanna Puang Allataala la tuttuam tiballa' kalua'
Ma'kada pole oom Puang Yesus naua: “Akam la dipasihhapangam kapahentaanna Puang Allataala?
Kapahentaanna Puang Allataala sihhapam mesa lise'na sesawi ditanam lako bela'. Ingganna tanangam ma'lise', lise'nam kaju sesawi handam bahinni'.
Sapo' tappana ditanam dio bela', iya tubom dio mai mahombo lambi' kasalle ia anna la tanangam senga' illaam bela', nasuhum mala naongei dassi ma'sehä täkena aka kationgam.”
Susim too Puang Yesus umpalanda' kadanna Puang Allataala sola ma'hupa-hupa pehapangam la malanna naissam to uhhingngii.
Dadi tä' deem si ma'tula' senga' ke tä'i nababa illaam pehapangam. Anna maka' lu lako mandi passikolanna si napomasiä' si mesa ia.
Puang Yesus umpamattam hibu' tatta'
Kahubenni indo allo eta too, ma'kada oom lako passikolanna naua: “Maikoa' anna ma'lopikia' lambam libam inde le'bo'.”
Iya umpelleim tau buda anna ma'mesai längäm indo lopi naongei muokko' Puang Yesus ingngena' aka la napasola lao. Yabo asanni, iya mengkalaom, anna budapi lopi senga' untuhu'i.
Sapo' tä'pi mambela-bela naola, anna sule ham hibu' tatta' sitonda bombam kasalle untappi indo lopinna, napolalam nasopa'i uwai, iya saidi' tatallam.
Wattu eta too mahassam Ia mamma' Puang Yesus dio ampa' illau' tämpä'na lopi. Iya natundammi napasindum naua: “O Tuangguhu akanna ma'lembe-lembe hako Iko? Moi kela daa la tallammakia'.”

Iya bangommi duka' anna umpamattanni indo hibu' tatta' anna mane ma'kada tama le'bo' naua: “Hapa'ko, mattangko!” Iya mattam siaham indo hibu' tatta' anna hapa' indo bombam sampe malino siaham indo le'bo'.
Puhai ia too ma'kadam lako passikolanna naua: “Akanna mahea' sugali' hakoa' iko? Tä' liu pokoka' tiko uhhannuannä'?”
Iya silelem mängä-mängä anna mane sipa'tula'-tula' naua: “Tau menna hia isanga inde! Aka moi hibu' sola bombam mala toi napahe'!”
